propositions: rebar bridge fsck reports store_integrity=13 due to 13 orphaned reverse keys (REB-410 through REB-422) with no matching forward bindings in .bridge_state/bindings.json
all 13 orphaned entries reference deleted ZZ-*TEST fixture tickets from a retired environment (env_id ade0f2ef-...), not the current store environment
the 13 reverse keys were removed from the binding store by deleting them from the reverse map without ad-hoc git, using BindingStore library and the sanctioned commit_and_push_tickets_branch door
after repair, rebar bridge fsck reports store_integrity=0 with bindings=2111 and reverse=2111 (delta reduced from 13 to 0), forward map unchanged, and bindings-retired.json unmodified

the repair asymptotically uncovered a code defect: BindingStore.unbind() only pops reverse keys when forward entries carry a jira_key, orphaning reverse keys when forward entries are removed by other paths
